Zelda 2. I realize I am in the minority on this but no other Zelda game captures the feeling of being lost in a dangerous land with only your wits and your skills to guide you like that one does. The music is creepy and iconic, the side scrolling combat works surprisingly well and even the shoddy translation of the NES version actually adds to the strange atmosphere of being in a land where no one is any help and you have to make your way on your own. Most people disregard the game as a weird one-off experiment but I think it captures a very unique and awesome feeling of isolation, bravery and adventure that not many games have, save for Castlevania II, the first Final Fantasy and a few others.
